@Haroenv There is 3 files in the gist (1 for `src/index.es.ts`, 1 for `src/widgets/index.ts` and 1 for `src/connectors/index.ts`), each of them containing `Hit` (this is normal since they were generated separately).

To get multiple files you can checkout this branch and run `yarn build` and check the `.d.ts` files in the `es` directory. May be it would be clearer?
